data.content_ref: inline:Cross-city modulator counterexample: arid cities. The target's cross-city mechanism (gap larger where green space/irrigation is less) is contradicted by arid-city observations, where rural surfaces are also dry, so the lack of urban vegetation does not widen the nocturnal UHI; the target even flags this countercondition ('If arid cities show weaker UHI because rural surfaces are also dry') but leaves it unresolved, so the single proposed modulator does not universally explain why the night-time gap is larger in some cities than in others.
